---
title: Feynman Technique
summary: Explain a concept in plain words to find the gaps in your understanding.
type: conceito
status: draft
origin: human
created: 2026-09-22
source:
tags:
  - estudo
---
Pick a concept, explain it as if teaching a child, and note where you stumble or fall back on jargon. Those gaps show what you do not really understand yet. Go back to the source, then simplify the explanation again. Pairs with [[Active Recall]].
